text: Ethics in AI is an important topic today. AI systems can be biased if they are trained on unfair data, which may lead to wrong or unfair decisions about people. Fairness means treating everyone equally, whatever their background. Privacy is also a serious concern, because AI often collects and uses personal information. Companies must protect this data and use it carefully. Transparency matters too: people should understand how AI makes decisions and be able to question them. Finally, responsible AI development means designers and governments working together to create clear rules. In this way, we can enjoy the benefits of AI while reducing its risks.
